blocking_rules: Do not call any paid API endpoint while money_ceiling is null.

Do not transmit document text to a hosted service unless a matching explicit authorization exists. The sole current exception to the general prohibition is selected public paper passages for annotation in this Codex session, under scoped_authorizations.codex_public_text_annotation.
Do not report a newly initialized encoder head as a software extractor.
Do not convert model failures or empty responses into successful empty extractions.

codex_public_text_annotation.purpose: Software-mention annotation and evidence checking for the SciBERT POC
codex_public_text_annotation.allowed_data: Selected public paper passages acquired through permitted open sources
